name: GeneralIntegratorInsertionSortCollider
description: This class is the adaptive version of the InsertionSortCollider and changes the NewtonIntegrator dependency of the collider algorithms to the Integrator interface which is more general.

attributes.name: sortAxis
attributes.description: Axis for the initial contact detection.

attributes.name: allowBiggerThanPeriod
attributes.description: If true, tests on bodies sizes will be disabled, and the simulation will run normaly even if bodies larger than period are found. It can be useful when the periodic problem include e.g. a floor modelized with wall/box/facet. Be sure you know what you are doing if you touch this flag. The result is undefined if one large body moves out of the (0,0,0) period.

attributes.name: sortThenCollide
attributes.description: Separate sorting and colliding phase; it is MUCH slower, but all interactions are processed at every step; this effectively makes the collider non-persistent, not remembering last state. (The default behavior relies on the fact that inversions during insertion sort are overlaps of bounding boxes that just started/ceased to exist, and only processes those; this makes the collider much more efficient.)

attributes.name: targetInterv
attributes.description: (experimental) Target number of iterations between bound update, used to define a smaller sweep distance for slower grains if >0, else always use 1*verletDist. Useful in simulations with strong velocity contrasts between slow bodies and fast bodies.

attributes.name: overlapTolerance
attributes.description: Tolerance on determining overlap. In rare cases different parts of the code can inconsistently lead to different results in terms of overlap, with false negative by spatialOverlapPeri possibly leading to nasty bugs in contact detection (false positive are harmless). This tolerance is to avoid false negative, the value can be understood as relative to 1 (i.e. independent of particle size or any other reference length). The default should be ok.

attributes.name: updatingDispFactor
attributes.description: (experimental) Displacement factor used to trigger bound update: the bound is updated only if updatingDispFactor*disp>sweepDist when >0, else all bounds are updated.

attributes.name: verletDist
attributes.description: Length by which to enlarge particle bounds, to avoid running collider at every step. Stride disabled if zero. Negative value will trigger automatic computation, so that the real value will be *verletDist* × minimum spherical particle radius; if there are no spherical particles, it will be disabled. The actual length added to one bound can be only a fraction of verletDist when

attributes.name: minSweepDistFactor
attributes.description: Minimal distance by which enlarge all bounding boxes; superseeds computed value of verletDist when lower that (minSweepDistFactor x verletDist).

attributes.name: fastestBodyMaxDist
attributes.description: Normalized maximum displacement of the fastest body since last run; if >= 1, we could get out of bboxes and will trigger full run. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: numReinit
attributes.description: Cummulative number of bound array re-initialization.

attributes.name: numAction
attributes.description: Cummulative number of collision detection.

attributes.name: doSort
attributes.description: Do forced resorting of interactions.

attributes.name: keepListsShort
attributes.description: if true remove bounds of non-existent or unbounded bodies from the lists (auto-updated); turned true automatically in MPI mode and if bodies are erased with

attributes.name: smartInsertErase
attributes.description: Use an algorithm optimized for heavy insert/delete (avoid initSort) - experimental.

attributes.name: newton
attributes.description: reference to active Newton integrator. (auto-updated)

attributes.name: strideActive
attributes.description: Whether striding is active (read-only; for debugging). (auto-updated)

attributes.name: periodic
attributes.description: Whether the collider is in periodic mode (read-only; for debugging) (auto-updated)

attributes.name: boundDispatcher
attributes.description: BoundDispatcher object that is used for creating bounds on collider's request as necessary.

attributes.name: avoidSelfInteractionMask
attributes.description: This mask is used to avoid the interactions inside a group of particles. To do so, the particles must have the exact same mask and that mask should have one bit in common with this

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.
